decisions.reason: The request for guidance about required front matter, back matter, and publication prerequisites does not resolve or change the separate ambiguity about the printed cover's text and presentation.
Requesting general front- and back-matter guidance does not change or remove the existing publication attribution line.
The new guidance topics do not alter the authoritative manuscript file, tracked edits, accepted passages, or table punctuation requirements.
Publication-readiness guidance about front matter and back matter does not change the Chapter 18 heading hierarchy or typography rules.
The guidance request does not change the requirements that chapter images preserve aspect ratio and avoid unintended cropping.
Adding specific publishing-guidance topics does not modify the manuscript's copyediting, sentence-clarity, or meaning-preservation requirements.
The request for publication prerequisite guidance does not change the selected paperback publication format.
The guidance request does not alter the inclusion, coverage, identification, or beginning-of-chapter placement of chapter images.
The new readiness-guidance topics do not change the permitted image source or the criteria for reviewing chapter-image suitability.
